candidates.label: Forgiveness and acceptance of repentance joined to severity and abundance
candidates.definition: In 40:3: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance; there is no deity except Him and to Him is the destination.

evidence.excerpt: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

candidates.definition: In 40:4: No one disputes concerning the signs except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their uninhibited movement throughout the land.

candidates.label: Throne-bearing angels interceding for believers and their righteous kin
candidates.definition: In 40:7-9: Those who carry the Throne and those around it exalt with praise, believe in Him and ask forgiveness for believers; our Lord, forgive those who repented and followed Your way, admit them to promised gardens with righteous fathers, spouses and offspring, and protect them from evil consequences, which is mercy and the great attainment.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

evidence.excerpt: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

candidates.label: Divine hatred exceeding self-hatred at the refused invitation to faith
candidates.definition: In 40:10: Those who disbelieve will be addressed that the hatred of Allah for them was greater than their hatred of themselves when they were invited to faith but refused.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ

candidates.label: Two deaths and two lives confessed with the plea for an exit refused
candidates.definition: In 40:11-12: They say our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice and we confess our sins, so is there any way to an exit; that is because when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved, and judgement is with Allah the Most High Grand.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The Day of Meeting with exposed sovereignty and exact recompense
candidates.definition: In 40:15-17: He places inspiration to warn of the Day of Meeting, the Day they come forth with nothing concealed; to whom belongs sovereignty this Day? To Allah the One the Prevailing; this Day every soul is recompensed for what it earned, no injustice today.

evidence.excerpt: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ

evidence.excerpt: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٞۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ

evidence.excerpt: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: State violence against believing sons while women are spared
candidates.definition: In 40:25: When he brought them the truth they said kill the sons of those who believed with him and keep their women alive, but the plan of the disbelievers is only in error.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ

candidates.label: Refuge sought in the shared Lord against arrogance denying the Day of Account
candidates.definition: In 40:27: Moses said I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Concealed faith defending the messenger through evidentiary fairness
candidates.definition: In 40:28: A believing man of Pharaoh's family who concealed his faith said do you kill a man because he says my Lord is Allah while bringing clear proofs; if he lies his lie is upon him, and if truthful some of what he promises will strike you.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ رَجُلٞ مُّؤۡمِنٞ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبٗا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقٗا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ كَذَّابٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Present political dominance unable to shield from divine punishment
candidates.definition: In 40:29: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, dominant in the land, but who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came? Pharaoh said I show you only what I see and guide you only to right conduct.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

candidates.label: Doubt persisting after Yusuf's proofs and the claim that no messenger would follow
candidates.definition: In 40:34: Joseph had come before with clear proofs but you remained in doubt until he died, then said never will Allah send a messenger after him; thus Allah leaves astray the transgressor and skeptic.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ مُّرۡتَابٌ

candidates.label: Tower construction to inspect the deity, its evil made attractive and plan ruined
candidates.definition: In 40:36-37: O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways into the heavens so I may look at the deity of Moses, though I think he is a liar; thus the evil of his deed was made attractive and he was averted from the way, and his plan was only in ruin.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ

evidence.excerpt: أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٖ

candidates.label: Worldly enjoyment against the Hereafter as the home of settlement
candidates.definition: In 40:39: O my people, this worldly life is only temporary enjoyment, and indeed the Hereafter is the home of permanent settlement.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَتَٰعٞ وَإِنَّ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ ٱلۡقَرَارِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Exact recompense for evil with unaccounted provision for believing men and women
candidates.definition: In 40:40: Whoever does an evil deed is recompensed only by its like, but whoever does righteousness, male or female, while a believer, enters Paradise given provision without account.

evidence.excerpt: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةٗ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

candidates.definition: In 40:41-42: How is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire? You invite me to disbelieve and associate without knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Invoked objects answering no supplication in either realm
candidates.definition: In 40:43: Assuredly that to which you invite me has no response to supplication in this world or the Hereafter, and our return is to Allah, and the transgressors are companions of the Fire.

evidence.excerpt: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

candidates.label: Entrustment of the affair to Allah answered by protection from plotted evils
candidates.definition: In 40:44-45: You will remember what I say to you and I entrust my affair to Allah, indeed Allah is Seeing of His servants; so Allah protected him from the evils they plotted and Pharaoh's people were enveloped by the worst punishment.

evidence.excerpt: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ

evidence.excerpt: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Morning-and-evening exposure to the Fire before the severest entry
candidates.definition: In 40:46: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening, and the Day the Hour appears it will be said make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوّٗا وَعَشِيّٗاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Support guaranteed to messengers and believers in both realms
candidates.definition: In 40:51: Indeed We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡأَشۡهَٰدُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Patience joined to forgiveness-seeking and timed praise
candidates.definition: In 40:55: So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, and ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Disputation traced to unreachable pride answered by refuge
candidates.definition: In 40:56: Those who dispute concerning the signs without authority have within their breasts only pride the extent of which they cannot reach, so seek refuge in Allah, indeed He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡ إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمۡ إِلَّا كِبۡرٞ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِۚ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Cosmic creation greater than human creation as a resurrection argument
candidates.definition: In 40:57: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

evidence.excerpt: لَخَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Invocation answered by promise with contempt for those disdaining worship
candidates.definition: In 40:60: And your Lord says call upon Me, I will respond to you; indeed those who disdain My worship will enter Hell rendered contemptible.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدۡعُونِيٓ أَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدۡخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

candidates.label: Staged human creation to an appointed term inviting reasoning
candidates.definition: In 40:67: It is He who created you from dust, then a sperm-drop, then a clinging clot, then brings you out as a child, then to maturity, then to old age, and among you is he taken before that, so that you reach a specified term and perhaps use reason.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُواْ شُيُوخٗاۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَجَلٗا مُّسَمّٗى وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Dragging in shackles through boiling water into the Fire
candidates.definition: In 40:71-72: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains they will be dragged, in boiling water, then in the Fire they will be filled with flame.

evidence.excerpt: إِذِ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسۡحَبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Vanished associates and the admission of having invoked nothing
candidates.definition: In 40:73-74: Then it will be said where is that which you used to associate other than Allah; they say they have departed from us, rather we did not used to invoke previously anything; thus Allah puts astray the disbelievers.

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالُواْ ضَلُّواْ عَنَّا بَل لَّمۡ نَكُن نَّدۡعُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Patience held whether punishment is witnessed or death intervenes
candidates.definition: In 40:77: So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, and whether We show you some of what We promised them or take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Signs brought only by permission with truthful conclusion at the command
candidates.definition: In 40:78: We sent messengers before you, some related and some not; it was not for any messenger to bring a sign except by permission of Allah, so when His command comes it is concluded in truth and the falsifiers lose.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُم مَّن قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Livestock and ships as combined carriage with further benefits
candidates.definition: In 40:79-80: It is Allah who made for you grazing animals upon which you ride and some you eat, and for you therein are other benefits and that you may realise upon them a need in your breasts, and upon them and upon ships you are carried.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ لِتَرۡكَبُواْ مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُواْ عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةٗ فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Land and sea transport as ayah.

candidates.label: Faith professed at the sight of punishment declared ineffective
candidates.definition: In 40:84-85: When they saw Our punishment they said we believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in what we associated; but never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment, the established way of Allah among His servants, and the disbelievers lost.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمۡ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَاۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِي عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
